assertions.assertion: Step 0.3 reads the Last-Updated timestamp from the security-matrix.md HTML comment and parses the ISO 8601 value
assertions.evidence: staleness-check.md lines 27-29 show the HTML comment '<!-- Last-Updated: 2026-05-01T10:00:00Z -->' and 'Parsed ISO 8601 value: 2026-05-01T10:00:00Z'. The timestamp is extracted and parsed correctly.

assertions.assertion: Step 0.3 detects that the matrix is older than the 14-day default threshold and displays a staleness warning
assertions.evidence: staleness-check.md lines 30-33 show 'Days since last update: 87 days', 'Default staleness threshold: 14 days' and 'Since 87 days exceeds the 14-day default threshold, the matrix is stale for both streams.' Warning blocks are displayed for both streams at lines 45-52 and 57-64.

assertions.assertion: The staleness warning includes the stream name, the last-updated date, and the number of days since the last update
assertions.evidence: staleness-check.md line 45-47 shows 'Warning: Security matrix for stream 2.1.x was last updated on 2026-05-01 (87 days ago).' This includes stream name (2.1.x), last-updated date (2026-05-01), and days since update (87 days ago). Same pattern for stream 2.2.x at lines 57-59.

assertions.assertion: The warning presents three options: refresh now (re-run setup Step 10.6), proceed anyway, or stop
assertions.evidence: staleness-check.md lines 49-52 present three options: '1. Refresh now -- re-run matrix population (setup Step 10.6) for this stream', '2. Proceed anyway -- continue triage with the current matrix', '3. Stop -- halt triage so I can investigate'.

assertions.assertion: Step 0.3 runs before Step 0.5 (JIRA Access Initialization) — no Jira operations are attempted before the staleness check
assertions.evidence: staleness-check.md lines 1-5 state 'This step executes before Step 0.5 (JIRA Access Initialization). No Jira operations have been attempted at this point -- the staleness check is the first validation after Step 0 configuration extraction.' Lines 80-82 confirm 'No Jira mutations or git show operations are performed until the staleness check is resolved.'
